crossing.transfer: federal operating subsidies to S&L mass transit (NIPA 3.13 line 7, federal 'Other'; unpublished transit part)

grid.label: a smaller stationary network: operations, depreciation, the capital return and lanes all follow the long-run road response (the September 27 case)
replacement adjustment: worn road capital is not replaced (depreciation follows the response) while the stock in place keeps its return and its lanes
a fixed stock: only operations follow the response; depreciation, the capital return and lanes stay
an upward stock: depreciation, the road capital return and lanes respond like highway construction across states (0.792, year effects)
an upward stock: depreciation, the road capital return and lanes respond like highway construction across states with a land control (0.758)
measured responses taken as r = b instead of the finite removal (capped responses stay 1)
within-state readings above 1 priced at the high end (highways 1.4225, parks 1.3759)
federal subfunctions held fixed at the high end too
S&L highways and parks at the across-state reading at the high end (no within-state reading)
every subfunction held at 0 (water, space, agriculture, energy, natural resources, postal, commercial) at 1 instead

range.note: account: v2's components plus the items' ranges, re-run on each base at every specification; joint: each variant's change in the account plus the congestion item at its band ends' lane cut (the dependent-pieces placement rule)
